narr: A slow-moving, tropical-like rain shower triggered a mud and debris flow near Fiddle Creek in Idaho County.
ev: A very heavy downpour on Fiddle Creek, dropped approximately 0.75 inches of rain in one hour. The heavy rainfall triggered a substantial mud and debris flow that closed the highway near milepost 201 for nearly two days. Despite the intensity of the storm, no lightning occurred ��� an unusual feature for the region. No vehicles were trapped.
